description: A loop of random values played back as a stepped or smoothed voltage, with control over how many steps the loop has and how fast the values change.

params.text: How much the CLK jack moves that rate.
The rate the loop steps at.
How many steps the loop has, from one to thirty-two.
How much the STEP jack moves the number of steps.
How fast the stored values drift to new random ones.
How much the MUT. jack moves that drift rate.
Sets how the steps are joined: up leaves them stepped, middle draws a straight line between them, down draws a curve.

inputs.text: Moves the drift rate, by as much as the MOD knob beside MUTATE allows.
Moves the number of steps, by as much as the MOD knob beside NB STEP allows.
A clock for the loop: a rising edge advances it, and the CLOCK knob is then read as a division of that clock.
Moves the loop's rate, by as much as the MOD knob beside CLOCK allows.
Replaces every value in the loop with a fresh random one on each rising edge.
Replaces the value of the next step with a fresh random one on each rising edge.

outputs.text: A second voltage from the same loop, offset from the first.

notes: Set Rack's sample rate to 96kHz before using this module. At any other rate it runs at the wrong speed, and a red bar appears across the bottom of the panel saying so.
An unpatched modulation CV jack does not read 0V: the firmware drives it from an internal chaotic generator, so a MOD knob turned up with nothing patched lets a wandering voltage through.
